# SM-03 — Browser safety

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Selectable
- **Applies when:** The app has a web UI.
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Lite
CSRF protection on state-changing routes; escaped output; no raw-HTML sinks.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-03-L1** A cross-origin state-changing request is refused. | auto | `test_report` |
| **SM-03-L2** No raw-HTML sinks (dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, v-html, \|safe) on untrusted data. | auto + review | `review_verdict` |

## Full
Lite, plus a strict CSP, the full security-header set and a seeded-XSS E2E test.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-03-F1** Header scan of the preview shows CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, frame-ancestors per SM-13, HSTS when HTTPS. | auto | `scan_report` |
| **SM-03-F2** A seeded XSS payload in every rendered input never executes in E2E. | auto | `e2e_report` |

## Code signals (mid-build detector, S5)
- Frontend framework or cookies
  - path: `\.(tsx|jsx|vue|svelte)$`
  - code: `\bdocument\.cookie\b`
  - code: `set-cookie`
  - code: `cookies\(\)`
